_comment: Tier-2 for febio::fluid#2, and a CORRECTION to one detail. A sweep of the `fluid` material's <k> over four decades on the shipped channel deck leaves the logged volume ratio fJ and dilatation fd BIT-IDENTICAL while the pressure fp moves at every value — the inlet and outlet prescribe the dilatation, so k controls nothing there. Separately, the log-variable rejection is per RECORD TYPE: <element_data data="ef"/> is refused with '"ef" is not a valid field variable name (line N)' while <node_data data="ef"/> is accepted and runs to normal termination. CORRECTION: the claim says the element_data rejection arrives after a successful read. It does not — the run prints 'Reading file ...FAILED!' and the message is part of that read failure. The asymmetry is real; the stage was wrong. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
